text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and your mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and try to avoid too much sugar and fast food. Second, exercise regularly — even a short walk every day can make a big difference. Third, make sure you get enough sleep, because your body needs rest to stay strong. Don't forget your mental health: talk to friends, take breaks, and spend time on hobbies you enjoy. Finally, keep a good work-life balance so you don't feel stressed all the time. Small daily habits can lead to a happier, healthier life.
